context:
Goal: a resumed failed run shows why it failed, and hides only the provider's raw text.
Problem (rule): the job row's error column holds both the server's own sentences and the provider's raw text, with nothing marking which is which (src/worker/reconcileWorker.ts writes error.message; claudeProvider.ts throws provider text unchanged).
Based on (read): today recoverRun (src/components/Chat.tsx) sends every reason through answerFailure (src/utils/plainReason.ts), which drops all but the network and no-key reasons.
Based on (read): the D-369 check's fixture error, "the worker gave up after three attempts", is not a sentence the product writes.
Departs from: main hides every resumed reason — the resumed view shows the row's reason.

options.gain: Hides only provider text, as 326 a says. Pipeline failures such as "No line items were extracted" also show. Fixes the cause; the D-369 fixture stays.
options.label: Mark the source at the server; the screen shows the row's text (recommended)
options.lose: A wider change: three throw families, the Jobs screen's error text changes, some tests re-pointed.

options.gain: Small, and it cannot leak provider text.
options.label: Allow-list three sentences on the screen: cancel, deadline, dead worker
options.lose: Pipeline failures stay hidden, short of "hides only"; the D-369 check's fixture changes.

reply:
12:15 CST, plainly: when a q_max run fails, the screen shows why. Some reasons are our own server's sentences. Some are raw text from the AI provider, which your 326 a said to hide. Both land in one field today. a: tag each reason where it is made, then show ours and hide the provider's. b: show only three known sentences. If you drop 326 a and show every reason, neither is needed.
You asked whether raw provider text is scary. Mostly it is just ugly: for example 'overloaded_error', a request id, or a rate-limit line. The API key is not normally sent back. Unchecked: I have not read q_max's provider code in this session, so a lane must confirm that no key or prompt text gets through. q_max is an internal tool, so the cost of showing it is confusion, not a leak.
short: q_max D-369: where the reason is sorted
title: q_max failed-run reason: mark provider errors at the server, or allow-list three sentences on the screen?
why: Follow-up to your 326 a. The screen cannot show the server's reason and hide the provider's raw text until one of these is built.
